states.description: Person eats from a bowl at the desk.

rules.trigger: Person takes the last spoonful from the bowl. or Person sits at the desk with hands resting after finishing eating.
rules.action: Pick up the bowl and place it in the dishwasher.

next.on: Person picks up the empty bowl.

states.description: Person drinks coffee and works on the laptop at the desk.

rules.trigger: Person types on a laptop with an empty can nearby.
rules.action: Pick up the can and place it in the designated storage area.

next.on: Person picks up the empty can.

states.description: Person drinks water and works on the laptop at the desk.

rules.trigger: Person types on a laptop with an empty glass mug nearby.
rules.action: Pick up the cup and place it in the dishwasher.

next.on: Person lifts an empty glass mug from the desk.

states.description: Person works at the desk, writing or typing.
